answer_1.quote: we define semantic interpretation of a PNC as a free-form paraphrase that exposes the implicit relation between the constituent nouns, if any relation exists, else identify it as non-compositional ([NON-CMP]).
answer_1.outputs: free-form paraphrases that expose the implicit relation between the constituent nouns in proper noun compounds

answer_2.quote: we propose a combination of classification-based metric and generation metrics to properly handle both the interpretable and non-interpretable cases, respectively

answer_4.quote: we manually annotate the quality of model predictions with respect to gold using a 3-index scale. The scale indicates whether the quality of the prediction is bad, average or good.
answer_4.guideline: The scale indicates whether the quality of the prediction is bad, average or good. This is done only for the cases where the gold annotation indicates that the compound is compositional and the prediction of the model is also a paraphrase, as semantic matching is applicable only in these cases.
